sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of desert pilgrims and the glassworkers of the dunes, against sun and blown sand. Four pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: the pilgrim's headcloth, a pale cloth over the head and down the neck, tied with a twisted cord; a cream head-wrap wound loosely round the head, one end hanging; a modest straw sun hat with a shallow cone crown and a brim no wider than the shoulders; a glassworker's close cap of scorched canvas with a neck flap. Every piece sits close on the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, golden sand, cream, ochre and indigo, lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
